phases.description: Establish the foundational creative vision for the game. The Game Director defines the high-level concept, tone, and creative pillars. The Story Writer produces the world lore bible, playable race profiles, 3-act narrative outline, and main character roster. All subsequent phases depend on these artifacts being locked and approved.
outputs: High Concept Document (1-page pitch)
World Lore Bible (world history, geography, factions)
Playable Race Profiles (5 races: stats tendency, innate ability, cultural identity)
3-Act Story Arc Outline
Main Character Roster (name, class, race, backstory summary)
Villain Profile and motivation document
Sidequest hooks list (15+ ideas)
completion_criteria: High Concept Document approved by Game Director
All 5 race profiles complete with stat tendencies and innate abilities defined
3-act arc has clear inciting incident, midpoint twist, and resolution
Main party has minimum 6 characters with distinct roles and backstories
QA Agent has reviewed for story consistency and no unresolved plot holes
Story Writer has signed off on narrative voice and tone consistency

phases.description: Translate story and concept into formal mechanical design. The Game Designer authors the complete GDD covering all systems: combat, skills, magic, races, progression, items, UI, and world structure. The Game Director reviews and approves. This document is the single source of truth for development, art, and audio.
outputs: Full Game Design Document (GDD)
Combat System Specification (turn order, action menu, damage formulas)
Skill System Design (skill trees per class, MP costs, unlock levels)
Magic System Design (6 elemental schools, spell tiers I-III, AoE rules)
Race Ability Tables (innate passives and actives per race)
Progression Curve Document (XP tables, stat growth per level per class)
Item and Equipment Taxonomy (categories, stat modifiers, rarity tiers)
UI Flow Diagrams (battle UI, menu UI, world map UI)
Enemy Design Roster (30+ enemy types with stats, skills, drop tables)
Balance Spreadsheet (skill power vs. MP cost ratio validation)
completion_criteria: GDD covers all game systems with no ambiguous or undefined mechanics
All skill and spell tables are complete with no placeholder values
Progression curve has been validated — no runaway power spikes before endgame
Enemy roster includes boss enemies for each major story chapter
Game Director has formally approved the GDD
QA Agent has reviewed for mechanical consistency and balance edge cases

phases.description: Implement all designed systems in Godot 4 using GDScript. The Core Developer builds the game architecture from the GDD specifications, producing modular, well-commented, and fully functional code. All core systems must be implemented, individually testable, and integrated before this phase closes.
outputs: BattleManager autoload (turn queue, action resolution, damage calculation)
SkillSystem autoload (skill data registry, skill execution, cooldown tracking)
MagicSystem autoload (spell registry, elemental affinity matrix, casting logic)
PartyManager autoload (roster management, formation, active party slot logic)
ProgressionManager autoload (XP, leveling, stat growth, skill unlock)
InventoryManager autoload (items, equipment, consumable use)
SaveLoadManager autoload (JSON-based save/load with slot support)
DialogueSystem (scene-based dialogue runner, branching, flag support)
SceneTransitionManager (fade in/out, async scene loading)
All battle scene scripts (BattleScene.gd, EnemyAI.gd, BattleUI.gd)
All world map scripts (WorldMap.gd, PlayerController.gd, EncounterSystem.gd)
All menu scripts (MainMenu.gd, PauseMenu.gd, InventoryMenu.gd, SkillMenu.gd)
completion_criteria: All autoloads registered and functional in Godot 4 project
Battle system can run a full fight from start to win/lose condition
Skills and magic resolve correctly per GDD formulas
Party member death and revival work correctly
Save and load round-trip works with no data loss
Scene transitions complete without errors or orphaned nodes
QA Agent code review passed — GDScript style guide compliant
Game Tester has executed smoke test suite with zero critical bugs

phases.description: Produce all visual assets for the game. The Game Artist defines the art direction, creates or specs all sprite sheets, tilesets, UI elements, character portraits, spell effects, and environmental art. All art must adhere to the defined pixel grid, palette, and animation standards.
outputs: Art Direction Document (palette definitions, grid standards, style guide)
Character Sprite Sheets (all party members, all races — idle, walk, battle, death)
Enemy Sprite Sheets (all 30+ enemies — idle, attack, hurt, death)
Environment Tilesets (towns, dungeons, overworld, interiors — 16x16 tiles)
Battle Background Art (10+ unique battle environments)
Character Portrait Set (all speaking characters — neutral, happy, sad, angry, surprised)
UI Asset Kit (buttons, windows, icons, health/MP bars, cursor, menus)
Spell and Skill Effect Sprites (all 6 elements, all tiers — particle sheets)
World Map Tiles and Overworld Sprite
Logo and Title Screen Art
Item and Equipment Icon Set (all items in inventory taxonomy)
completion_criteria: All character sprites complete with walk and battle animation sets
Consistent palette used across all assets — no off-grid pixels
All UI elements match flow diagrams from GDD
Spell effect sprites cover all 6 elemental schools at all 3 tiers
Game Director has approved art direction and final asset set
QA Agent has reviewed for pixel grid alignment and palette compliance

phases.description: Compose, source, and catalogue all audio assets for the game. The Sound Designer defines the audio direction, creates music tracks for all environments and situations, and specs every SFX cue. All audio must be integrated with Godot's audio bus system and mapped to game events.
inputs: World Lore Bible (for thematic tone per region)
Art Direction Document (for visual-audio synergy reference)
Battle System Specification (for battle audio cue mapping)
outputs: Audio Direction Document (tone, instrumentation, loop points, BPM ranges)
World Map Theme (looping, 2:00+ runtime)
Town Themes (3 distinct town archetypes — peaceful, bustling, mysterious)
Dungeon Themes (3 distinct dungeon types — cave, ruins, castle)
Battle Theme (normal encounters — high energy, looping)
Boss Battle Theme (climactic, layered, looping)
Victory Fanfare (short, punchy, satisfying)
Game Over Sting (melancholic, 5-10 seconds)
Level Up Jingle (celebratory, 3-5 seconds)
Title Screen Theme (atmospheric, sets tone)
SFX Library: UI (click, open, close, confirm, cancel, error)
SFX Library: Battle (sword swing, magic cast per element, skill activate, hit, miss, critical)
SFX Library: World (footsteps on 3 surfaces, door open/close, chest open, item pickup)
SFX Library: Status (poison tick, silence, stun, heal, revive)
Audio Integration Map (event trigger → audio file mapping JSON)
completion_criteria: All music tracks loop seamlessly at defined loop points
SFX library covers every audio event defined in the integration map
Audio files are in OGG format for Godot compatibility
Battle audio cues are timed to match animation frame events
Game Director has approved audio direction and final track list
QA Agent has reviewed audio integration map for completeness

phases.description: Systematically test every feature, mechanic, and player path. The Game Tester authors and executes comprehensive test plans. The QA Agent performs a final cross-phase audit of all deliverables for consistency, compliance, and quality. All critical and high-severity bugs must be resolved before proceeding to launch.
outputs: Master Test Plan document
Battle System Test Cases (100+ cases covering all mechanics)
Skill and Magic Interaction Test Matrix
Race Ability Trigger Test Cases
Party Management Test Cases (death, revival, swap, formation)
Save/Load Integrity Test Report
Scene Transition Regression Test Report
UI Responsiveness Test Report
Bug Report Registry (all found bugs with severity, repro steps, status)
QA Cross-Phase Audit Report (code style, art consistency, design balance, story consistency)
Sign-off Checklist (all critical bugs resolved, all QA gates passed)
completion_criteria: Zero critical severity bugs open
Zero high severity bugs open (or formally accepted with documented risk)
All 100+ battle system test cases passed
Save/load round-trip tested across all 3 save slots with no data corruption
All 6 elemental spell schools resolve correctly at all 3 tiers
Race innate abilities trigger correctly in all tested scenarios
QA Agent cross-phase audit report shows no unresolved consistency violations
Game Director has reviewed and accepted the QA sign-off checklist

phases.description: Prepare and execute the game release across all target platforms. The Game Launcher configures Godot export presets, manages version tagging, writes release notes and store page copy, and defines the post-launch support plan. The QA Agent performs final pre-release validation.
inputs: All built and tested game assets
Bug Report Registry (for known issues list)
outputs: Godot Export Presets file (Windows x64, Linux x64, macOS universal, Web/HTML5)
Export Build Artifacts (all platform binaries and web build)
Version Tag (SemVer: v1.0.0)
Release Notes (full feature list, known issues, credits)
itch.io Store Page Copy (title, short description, long description, tags)
Steam Page Copy (capsule art spec, description, system requirements)
Launch Checklist (pre-launch, launch day, post-launch verification steps)
Post-Launch Support Plan (hotfix policy, patch schedule, community channels)
Press Kit (screenshots, GIF captures, key art, fact sheet)
completion_criteria: All platform export builds complete and tested on target hardware
Web build loads correctly in Chrome, Firefox, and Edge
Version tag v1.0.0 created in repository
Release notes reviewed and approved by Game Director
Store pages complete with all required assets and metadata
QA Agent has performed final pre-release smoke test on all platform builds
Launch checklist signed off by Game Launcher and QA Agent

message_format.message_type: one of: deliverable | feedback | approval | question | escalation
message_format.subject: string — brief subject line
message_format.attachments: array of artifact names being referenced
message_format.priority: one of: low | normal | high | critical

escalation_path: game_tester → qa_agent (bug reports and test failures)

quality_gates.name: Story Lock Gate
criteria: World lore has no internal contradictions
All 5 race profiles are complete
Story arc has defined beginning, middle, and end
Character roster approved by Game Director

quality_gates.name: GDD Approval Gate
criteria: GDD is complete with no undefined mechanics
Balance spreadsheet shows no degenerate strategies
All race abilities are unique and thematically appropriate
UI flow diagrams cover all player-facing screens

quality_gates.name: Code Review Gate
criteria: All autoloads registered and stable
GDScript style guide compliance verified
No orphaned nodes or memory leaks detected
Core game loop playable end-to-end

quality_gates.name: Art Consistency Gate
criteria: All assets on defined pixel grid
Palette compliance verified across all sprites
Animation frame counts match spec
No missing assets from GDD asset list

quality_gates.name: Audio Completeness Gate
criteria: All audio events in integration map have corresponding audio files
All music tracks loop without audible gap
OGG format compliance for all files
Audio bus routing spec complete

quality_gates.name: QA Sign-Off Gate
criteria: Zero open critical bugs
Zero open high bugs (or all formally accepted)
All test cases executed and documented
Cross-phase audit clean

quality_gates.name: Release Readiness Gate
criteria: All platform builds verified
Store pages complete and submitted
Version tag created in repository
Post-launch support plan published
